title: report_prose
description: The writer's prose for REPORT.md under C8 (Implementation Decisions 11): one paragraph for each claim group the prompt listed, and one on the negative results. Every claim sentence ends with provenance tags copied from the evidence the prompt gave; code renders everything else in the report from the ledger, and the linter checks every sentence of this prose.

groups.description: one paragraph per claim group, in the prompt's order; a group the prompt did not name is dropped

group.description: the group's key, exactly as the prompt printed it

text.description: the paragraph: what the findings of this group establish, every claim sentence ending with its tags

negative_results.description: one paragraph on what did not work, every claim sentence ending with its tags; the empty string when the prompt listed no negative result
